emotional_tone: Warm, intellectual, calm, editorial, scripture-focused studio room built for long writing and episode planning sessions

workspace_side_by_side.right_pane: lg:col-span-7 bg-[#FFFDF9] border border-[#E2DACD] p-6 rounded-xl shadow-sm space-y-6 flex flex-col justify-between max-h-[85vh] overflow-y-auto

login.style: Warm paper card with soft serif branding, clean credentials input, demo login buttons, and high contrast submit CTA.

episode_intake_form.style: Clean multi-field editorial form (Topic, Show Title, Scripture Reference, Selected Planning Template, Target Duration). Features real-time similar-episode warning banner when topic/scripture matches past database records.

outline_workspace.style: Left panel shows Scripture study text, theme notes, and template guidelines. Right panel features an interactive outline builder with section blocks (Hook, Main Points, Scriptures, Application, Conclusion), AI revision input prompt, version history side-drawer, and 'Approve Outline' button.

script_workspace.style: Dual-pane writing workspace. Generates complete timestamped episode script based on approved outline and template. Supports custom revision prompts ('Expand exegesis', 'Add pastoral tone'), live section copy, and DOCX file export.

episode_library.style: Structured catalog of past and active Bible Bytes episodes. Includes search input by topic/scripture, filter tabs by status and theme, data table/cards, and detail drawer.

settings_panel.style: Tabbed configuration view for User Management, AI Provider & API Keys (Gemini / OpenAI toggle, model picker, secret key input), and Reference Documents uploader (.docx planning template & sample past episodes).

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Use ONLY JavaScript (.js / .jsx) files - DO NOT create TypeScript (.ts / .tsx) files in frontend/src.
Add Google Fonts link for 'Newsreader' and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' in frontend/public/index.html head tag.
Ensure all interactive buttons, inputs, links, tabs, and status cards have explicit data-testid attributes.
Never rely on pure transparent backgrounds for headers, dropdowns, or modals. Use backdrop-blur-md bg-[#FAF7F2]/90 or bg-[#FFFDF9].
Follow generous spacing (p-6, p-8, gap-6) and use subtle warm borders (#E7E0D6 / #E2DACD) with card surfaces (#FFFDF9).
Implement Sonner toast notifications (from src/components/ui/sonner) for key actions like Outline Approval, Script Generation, DOCX Export, and API Key saving.
Use Lucide React icons for clean, readable editorial UI (e.g., BookOpen, Sparkles, CheckCircle2, FileText, Settings, Key, Search, Copy, Download, Layers).
